milestones.title: Real app icons in the dashboards + Windows-style Game Boost view module
milestones.desc: The Game Boost and Connection Monitor tables, the running-apps picker and the boost cards now show the REAL shell icon of every executable (resolved by a new host AppIconService via SHGetFileInfo, cached per path, fetched on demand through a new get_app_icons action). Two standalone modules (Temalar/boost-view.js + Temalar/monitor-view.js, loaded after app.js) add Windows-Explorer-style view modes: Details plus Small / Medium / Large icon grids with the original icons, and grouping with collapsible headers — Game Boost by Route/Status/Type, Connection Monitor also by Protocol/State/Country/Application — each with its own toolbar, styles and localStorage preferences, honouring the existing filters and driving the same set_app_route / remove_app contracts as the tables. The standalone skins (NEXUS, CYBER, INFRA) share the same icon cache through skinBridge.appIcons — NEXUS Game Profiles rows, boost cards and pickers, CYBER source cards and INFRA app rows show the real icons, and NEXUS gets its own view-mode module with icon grids and Route/Status/Type grouping.

milestones.title: Per-app WARP node picker replaces the Settings → GPN bypass editor
milestones.desc: The Settings → GPN tab (VLESS bypass + launcher-bypass domain editor) is removed. Each app's WARP route now shows a node picker next to it — pick any node from your list (Italy, Germany, South Africa…) and that app's WARP traffic exits through that node's egress (WireGuard nodes get their own wg-<id> tunnel, other protocols a warp-<id> proxy outbound); unresolvable/deleted nodes fall back to the default WARP egress automatically.

milestones.title: Dashboard canvas effects engine wired up: cursor trails, matrix rain and confetti are live again
milestones.desc: The dashboard's canvas effects engine was defined but never started — cursor trails, the per-theme cursor rings, matrix rain and the connect-confetti silently did nothing. The engine now initializes once at boot (every loop self-stops when idle), the trail colour is a literal theme triplet instead of an unresolved CSS var(), and the cursor canvas is HiDPI-crisp. Locked by 5 new integration tests including the reduced/balanced motion tiers.

milestones.title: Splash-free boot: invisible startup with a fade-in reveal
milestones.desc: The main window now starts invisible and fades in (~120 ms) only after the WebView2 dashboard has loaded its initial state — no more empty black frame while the browser boots — and the startup splash screen is removed entirely. Reveal also fires on navigation failure, tray-startup restore and a 15 s fallback timer, so the window can never stay invisible.

milestones.title: Shell declutter: legacy toolbar and Servers tab removed
milestones.desc: The hidden legacy toolbar (17 single-protocol Add-server items, five Subscription items and the option/routing/DNS/hotkey/clear-stats menus) and the old Servers tab are removed; node management lives solely in the dashboard Nodes view while Import (clipboard) and Scan (QR) stay.

milestones.title: Global TUN migrated to Mihomo: complete Sing-box purge
milestones.desc: The last sing-box paths are gone: Global TUN now runs on Mihomo like the GPN tunnel, the sing-box config/service/tests were purged, the csproj core-asset and wintun checks target mihomo/xray, and the test-DB leakage between runs is fixed.

milestones.title: Launcher bypass editor: per-launcher domain + egress rows
milestones.desc: The fixed BSG launcher domain list is replaced by a user-editable per-launcher domain + egress (WARP / VLESS / DIRECT) list managed in Dashboard Settings → GPN; an empty list disables launcher rows and null keeps the legacy defaults, still working with dual-connection mode.

milestones.title: WARP degrade-egress: launcher DIRECT fallback on faulted WARP
milestones.desc: While the WARP egress is faulted, launcher requests automatically fall back to DIRECT (clean exit instead of hitting the Cloudflare WAF) and switch back when WARP health returns — with a dashboard Degraded badge and i18n keys in all 9 languages.

milestones.title: Capture-gap hardening: first-tick PID capture + capture-drift warning
milestones.desc: A game spawning during connection setup now enters the WinDivert filter in ~750 ms instead of up to 5 s (silent while the PID set is unchanged), and a 'live connections but 0 captured packets' rose banner warns when the capture bridge stalls.

milestones.title: Structural rule edits deferred to the next natural reconnect
milestones.desc: Rule edits that change the routing structure no longer restart the core mid-match — they are deferred to the next natural reconnect so a live session is never dropped by an edit.

milestones.title: Speedtest empty-selection crash fixed
milestones.desc: SpeedtestService no longer throws OverflowException on an empty selection: the early exit now covers Tcping/Realping/UDP alike and an empty run reports 'stopped' instead of 'completed'.

milestones.title: P0 Wave 3: DashboardNodeService + DashboardPushService extracted
milestones.desc: DashboardNodeService (969 lines) and DashboardPushService (659) extracted from MainWindow (7,071 → ~3,981 lines); ConnectionFailureLedger moved the failure-card record/priority and 45 s freshness window into a testable ServiceLib service with 16 new tests; every moved member was verified byte-identical.
